allocation_microbenchmark.scope: Value to Value using same foundation science kernel; Rust global allocation calls and requested new byte sizes (realloc counted), not live memory, C malloc, HTTP or complete host boundary.

normalization: Outer host execution identity/elapsed envelope excluded
Top-level provider/runtime runtime_identity and resource_identity excluded
All other semantic/evidence data compared, including exact core_reply_json bytes
confounders: Shared hbox not isolated;24logical/16physical CPUs, load1 varied14.41 to31.10 (0.60 to1.30 per logical CPU). No process affinity isolation.
Original listener polls with20ms sleeps. Pure HTTP latencies near20ms mask internal savings.
Cold startup is fresh process with warm OS cache and includes image/solver hashing, opening state/journal and readiness; no cache flush.
The reader workloads include two retained answer_form refusals and one answered retained control. A refusal is not counted as successful answer throughput.
At8clients capacity4 about half requests are429; requested throughput must not be read as answered throughput.
New tenant_capacity and execution_fuel knobs cannot be supplied to old strict config parser. Their policy probes are foundation-only, not matched speed comparisons.

Foundation float_roundtrip fixes old JSON rounding. Performance fixtures use integer coefficients/strings rather than difficult decimal tokens; equality here does not establish universal numeric equivalence.

Initial global proc scan misses short solver children. Final memory-only probe uses owned task children and2ms wait; max_processes2 observed. Sampling still can miss peaks and RSS double-counts shared pages.
AB PSS/private missing because parser erroneously tried numeric parsing of smaps00:00 header; corrected BA/memory probe values retained. Missing values are null, not zero.
Observer normalization initially compared deployment IDs and provider timings; receipt recomputes semantic equality with the explicitly listed exclusions. Raw replies remain in scratch artifacts.
Exploratory logic descriptor carried TENANT placeholder and returned403. Corrected final AB/BA use actual64a tenant; exploratory artifacts retained, excluded from final matched workload totals.
No p50/p95 confidence intervals, CPU billing, private heap live accounting, retained-session slope, or cancellation preemption guarantee claimed.
